entries.title: Tell HN: You can't hire because you don't post salary ranges
entries.author: Carrok
entries.current_title: Tell HN: You can't hire because you don't post salary ranges
entries.excerpt: At the start of this year, Colorado has changed to require every job posted to list a salary range. Other states are also beginning to follow suit. I am currently job hunting. I started looking locally, everything lists salary ranges, perfect. I can know which positions to skip and which ones might be a good match right away. entries.title: Ask HN: YouTube Channels for the Intellectually Curious
entries.author: maxutility
entries.current_title: Ask HN: YouTube Channels for the Intellectually Curious
entries.excerpt: As someone who is intellectually curious and has had great success finding articles on sites like Hacker News and blogs like kottke.org, I haven’t yet figured out where to find the most interesting content on YouTube. Let me know in the comments if you have found certain channels and creators to be particularly rewarding to follow, or if there are other ways you’ve found to consistently track down good content.
entries.guide_zh: 求知欲旺盛的观众该看哪些 YouTube 频道，才能持续发现有趣知识？

entries.title: Tell HN: Internet Archive is facing a Big 4 Publishers lawsuit
entries.author: antiverse
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Internet Archive is facing a Big 4 Publishers lawsuit
entries.excerpt: Not sure why this isn't more prominently highlighted, but this is a very culturally significant project and a custodian of a tremendous amount of Internet and WWW-oriented history. I would imagine HN would put this at the forefront of the discussions happening here. I'm not affiliated, but I am a concerned netizen. All of us here have benefited from The IA. entries.author: apignotti
entries.current_title: Tell HN: We are trying to get tail calls into the WebAssembly standard

entries.title: Ask HN: How to keep my daughter busy while tickling her curiosity
